project.title: Murine IgG (polyclonal) from Listeria Challenged pregnant dams
project.projectDescription: IgG was collected from virgin and pregnant listeria challenged mouse plasma. Polyclonal IgG was analyzed by reduction, alkylation, and LC-MS with top-down MS/MS (HCD and ETD)to look for glycosylation PTMs
project.sampleProcessingProtocol: Samples were provided as polyclonal IgG samples. IgG was reduced, alkylated, and digested with sequencing grade trypsin. A ~1ug sample was used for injection with a nanoflow C18 column attached to a Thermo Ecclipse Orbitrap MS system.
project.dataProcessingProtocol: Data was processed with the commercial software Byonic against a uniprot search of IgG2 fasta against a database of known IgG N-glycans. MS1 ppm error was set to 5ppm and MS2 ppm error was set to 10ppm.
